properties.name: WILDCAT HOLLOW TRAILHEAD
properties.publicUse: USFS recreation site; verify current season, fees, access and closures.

details.description: This trail offers two options; a 17.2-mile loop of scenic trail along ridge-tops and stream bottoms, and a short 5-mile loop for day hikes. Both trails will lead through tall pine forests, open meadows, quiet streams, rock outcroppings, and down old roads overlooking miles of beautiful landscape. You will also pass some of our land management activities. Wildflowers are at their peak in the spring, but we ask that you not pick them so that others may also enjoy them. The hiker who treads softly can often catch glimpses of the wildlife who call the forest home. Bring your binoculars and enjoy your visit. This area is one of the recommended wildflower viewing areas on the Forest. Dispersed camping is allowed at the Wildcat Hollow Trail and Trailhead. When parking, help prevent damage to the grassy areas by staying on the gravel surface.
details.feeDescription: No fees are required for this site
details.directions: To access this trailhead, take State Route 13 north from Athens. Turn at the sign past Tom Jenkins dam. There are two exits, CR 16 (Irish Ridge Road) then take a right onto Township Road 298. The road curves around to the left and should take you to the parking lot which should be marked. GPS Lat/Long coordinates for the trailhead is 39 deg 34' 22" / 82 deg 01' 58".

Turn left and travel 0.75 miles to the roundabout on old Hwy. 33.  Head north on old Hwy. 33 for approximately 4 miles to Twp. Rd 336.
details.siteContactNotes: For more information, contact Athens District Ranger's Office at (740) 753-0101.

properties.name: PINES PICNIC AREA
properties.publicUse: USFS recreation site; verify current season, fees, access and closures.

details.description: This day use area has several picnic tables located around a shaded park-like setting below the Lake Vesuvius dam. Ample parking, water, grills, and tables, and a quaint bridge make this a picturesque place to spend a few hours. It is across from the Vesuvius Furnace and near hiking trails.
details.feeDescription: No fees are required for this site
details.hours: Day use only; no overnight camping allowed
details.directions: Located 6.5 miles north of Ironton, Ohio, just off State Route 93. Turn on County Road 29 and follow the signs to the Recreation Area (1 mile). Just past the entrance to the recreation area on the left the picnic area is at the base of the dam. The parking lot is across from the historic iron furnace stack.
details.siteContactNotes: For more information, contact Ironton District Ranger's Office at (740) 534-6500.

properties.name: LONGBOW ARCHERY ACCESSIBLE TRAILHEAD
properties.publicUse: USFS recreation site; verify current season, fees, access and closures.

details.description: The Longbow Archery Accessible Trail is a gem among the Wayne National Forest. This trail provides a short accessible route to the Longbow Archery Trail where archery enthusiasts can to hone their archery skills at the Lake Vesuvius Recreation Area.
details.feeDescription: No fees are required for this site
details.directions: From Ironton, Ohio, take State Route 93 north 6.5 miles. Turn on County Road 29 and follow the signs to the Lake Vesuvius Recreation Area (1 mile).  Once at the recreation area, take first road to the left (at the Lake Vesuvius Sign) and go 1/2 mile and the Longbow Archery Trailhead will be on your left across from the boat launch parking area.
details.siteContactNotes: For more information, contact Ironton District Ranger's Office at (740) 534-6500.

properties.name: BLUEGRASS TRAILHEAD
properties.publicUse: USFS recreation site; verify current season, fees, access and closures.

details.description: BLUEGRASS TRAILHEAD (Trailhead)
details.directions: From Ironton, OH, proceed north on State Route 93 for approximately 6.5 miles.  Turn right onto County Road 29 (Elkins Creek Rd.).  Drive for about one mile. The Bluegrass Horse trailhead will be on the right.  GPS Lat/Long coordinates for the area are 38 deg 61' 78" N / 82 deg 55' 78" W.
details.siteContactNotes: For more information, contact Ironton District Ranger's Office at (740) 534-6500.

properties.name: TECUMSEH LAKE DAY USE AREA
properties.publicUse: USFS recreation site; verify current season, fees, access and closures.

details.description: This 4-acre pond south of Shawnee, Ohio contains a variety of species of fish such as bass, bream, and catfish.  It offers a secluded fishing experience for interested anglers.
details.feeDescription: No fees are required for this site
details.hours: Day use only; no overnight camping allowed
details.directions: From U.S. Highway 33, take State Highway 595 north to New Straitsville, Ohio. Take a left onto Highway 216 (Main Street) and travel for 0.12 miles and turn right onto State Highway 93 north for 2.3 miles to access road on right.  Go 500 feet to arrive at pond.
details.siteContactNotes: For more information, contact Athens District Ranger's Office at (740) 753-0101.

properties.name: SALT CONNECTOR TRAILHEAD
properties.publicUse: USFS recreation site; verify current season, fees, access and closures.

details.description: Salt Connector Trailhead (Trailhead)
details.directions: From the intersection of State Rt. 155 and 93 in Shawnee, OH, travel approximately 1.5 miles north on State Rt. 93 to Old Town Rd.  Turn left onto Old Town Rd.  Travel on Old Town Rd. which will turn into Town Hwy. 136 at approximately 1.25 miles.  Continue straight on Township Rd. 136 for another 0.3 miles to Township Rd. 190.  Take a right onto Township Rd. 190 and travel for approximately 1.3 miles when Township Rd. 190 takes a sharp turn to the left.  Stay on Township Rd. 190 for another 0.6 miles until it forks.  Take the left fork and travel 0.2 miles to the trailhead (on left).  GPS Lat/Long coordinates for the area are 39 deg 36'58" N / 82 deg 17' 07" W.
details.siteContactNotes: For more information, contact Athens District Ranger's Office at (740) 753-0101.

properties.name: TWO POINTS GROUP CAMPGROUND
properties.publicUse: USFS recreation site; verify current season, fees, access and closures.

details.description: This group campground is located above the lake between the beach and the boat launch. The capacity of the group campground is 50 people. There is a group picnic shelter on site. 6 fire rings and 4 barbeque grills at site. 1 water hydrant. Amphitheater near site. 10 tents allowed on site. Horseshoe pits. Shelter size is 16' x 20' with 4 picnic tables in the shelter and 3 tables in the general area.
details.feeDescription:
Overnight Use:
Group Site: $35 per night
details.directions: Located 6.5 miles north of Ironton, Ohio, just off State Route 93. Turn on County Road 29 and follow the signs to the Recreation Area (1 mile). Turn at the entrance to the recreation area to the left and go past the lake and the boat dock. The campground is approximately one mile up this road on the left across from Pine Knob Campground.
details.siteContactNotes: For more information, contact Ironton District Ranger's Office at (740) 534-6500.

properties.name: SYCAMORE TRAILHEAD
properties.publicUse: USFS recreation site; verify current season, fees, access and closures.

details.description: This trailhead is part of the Monday Creek OHV Trail System. The Monday Creek area of the Wayne National Forest provides some excellent opportunities for riding off-highway vehicles (OHVs). This trail system, north of Nelsonville, provides approximately 75 miles of designated trails to off-highway vehicle riders, mountain bikers, and hikers. Loading ramps are available at the New Straitsville and White Oak Trailheads.
details.feeDescription:
Day Use:
Non-motorized Trail Use: No fee
Motorized Trail Use: $20 per person per three day; $35 per person per season
details.directions: From Columbus, take U.S. Hwy. 33 to State Route 595/Haydenville Exit.  Turn right towards Haydenville, OH. Go through the town of Haydenville pass the sawmill to Twp. Rd 336.  Take a left onto Twp. Rd 336 and travel approximately 670 feet to Company Road.  Turn right on Company Road and travel approximately 1/2 mile to the Sycamore Trailhead which is the first trailhead on the right.  From Athens, take the second Nelsonville exit off U.S. Hwy. 33.  Turn left and travel 0.75 miles to the roundabout on old Hwy. 33.  Head north on old Hwy. 33 for approximately 4 miles to Twp. Rd 336.
details.siteContactNotes: For more information, contact Athens District Ranger's Office at (740) 753-0101.
